create_multimodal_embedding: create a multimodal embedding by posting text and image input to the /v1/embeddings endpoint
build_embedding_payload: build a JSON payload with model name and multimodal input containing text and image URL for embedding request
run_embedding_server: run the SGLang embedding server with a vision-language model for multimodal embedding generation
parse_embedding_response: parse the embedding API response and extract embedding vectors from the data array
test_multimodal_embedding_api: test the multimodal embedding API with text and image input via POST request to /v1/embeddings
